title: AI-Augmented Surveys: Leveraging Large Language Models and Surveys for Opinion Prediction
reasoning: The paper evaluates the performance of LLMs in predicting human opinions on moral, ethical, and social issues using the General Social Survey (GSS) as ground truth. Specific tasks involve predicting responses to questions about personal morality (e.g., homosexual relationships), religious convictions, and ethical lifestyle choices (e.g., refusing meat for moral reasons).
